description: 🎙️ Offline voice productivity for Windows - dictate text into any app and control a local AI assistant by voice. Manages notes, to-do lists, appointments & reminders. 100% local: faster-whisper + Ollama + SQLite. No cloud, no telemetry. Free and open source alternative to Wispr Flow
